```artifact
Feature: Software Clocks and Algorithms

  Scenario: Software Clocks Do Not Overflow Within 2 Weeks
    Given the software clock is initialized with a value of 0
    When 14 days pass
    Then the software clock value should not exceed 2,147,483,647

  Scenario: Software Clocks Do Not Overflow Within 2 Weeks (Edge Case)
    Given the software clock is initialized with a value of 2,147,483,648
    When 1 day pass
    Then the software clock value should not exceed 2,147,483,647

  Scenario: Software Clocks Do Not Overflow Within 2 Weeks (Invalid Case)
    Given the software clock is initialized with a value of -1
    When 1 day pass
    Then the software clock value should not exceed 2,147,483,647

  Scenario: Numeric Algorithms Do Not Lose Stability Over 2 Weeks
    Given the software clock is initialized with a value of 0
    When 14 days pass
    Then the software clock value should be within 1 of the initial value

  Scenario: Software Algorithms Are Runnable in Faster Than Real Time
    Given the software clock is initialized with a value of 0
    When 1 day pass
    Then the software clock value should be greater than the initial value

  Scenario: Software Is Power-Efficient Enough to Continuously Work From Battery for 1 Hour
    Given the initial battery level is 50
    When 1 hour pass
    Then the battery level should be greater than or equal to 50

  Scenario: Software Is Power-Efficient Enough to Continuously Work From Battery for 1 Hour (Edge Case)
    Given the initial battery level is 0
    When 1 hour pass
    Then the battery level should be greater than or equal to 0

  Scenario: Software Is Power-Efficient Enough to Continuously Work From Battery for 1 Hour (Invalid Case)
    Given the initial battery level is -1
    When 1 hour pass
    Then the battery level should be greater than or equal to 0

  Scenario: Controller Can Detect Patient Inspiration
    Given the patient is breathing
    When the controller is running
    Then the controller should detect patient inspiration

  Scenario Outline: Software Clocks Do Not Overflow Within 2 Weeks (Examples)
    Given the software clock is initialized with a value of <clock_value>
    When <days> days pass
    Then the software clock value should not exceed 2,147,483,647

    Examples:
      | clock_value | days |
      | 0           | 14   |
      | 2,147,483,648 | 1    |
      | -1          | 1    |

  Scenario Outline: Software Algorithms Are Runnable in Faster Than Real Time (Examples)
    Given the software clock is initialized with a value of <clock_value>
    When <days> days pass
    Then the software clock value should be greater than the initial value

    Examples:
      | clock_value | days |
      | 0           | 14   |
      | 2,147,483,648 | 1    |
      | -1          | 1    |

  Scenario Outline: Software Is Power-Efficient Enough to Continuously Work From Battery for 1 Hour (Examples)
    Given the initial battery level is <battery_level>
    When <hours> hours pass
    Then the battery level should be greater than or equal to <battery_level>

    Examples:
      | battery_level | hours |
      | 50            | 1     |
      | 0             | 1     |
      | -1            | 1     |
```
